personal_info.name: Pradeep Bhattarai

personal_info.tagline: I architect and build scalable real-time systems, resilient backends, and production mobile applications.
personal_info.bio: I'm Pradeep Bhattarai, a Software Engineer (Full Stack & Mobile) with a Bachelor's in Computer Engineering from Pulchowk Engineering Campus (IOE) and an ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC) credential. I specialize in architecting production cross-platform mobile apps using Flutter and engineering horizontally scalable backend services with Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL (PostGIS), and Redis. Passionate about real-time streaming, distributed systems, clean architecture, and defensive security.

experience.description: Architected and shipped production cross-platform mobile apps in Flutter and developed high-throughput backend services and REST APIs in Node.js, Express, and TypeScript.
achievements: Architected and shipped production Flutter applications (Icebreaker) with custom Google Maps clustering, on-device Google ML Kit face liveness verification, and Clean Architecture (BLoC)
Engineered backend microservices with Node.js, Express, and TypeScript, leveraging Prisma ORM and PostgreSQL (PostGIS) for low-latency spatial queries and geospatial indexing
Implemented real-time presence synchronization and messaging using Socket.IO with Redis Streams/Adapter and BullMQ task queues for horizontal scalability
Automated multi-platform CI/CD release pipelines using Codemagic for Play Store/App Store and GitHub Actions with Docker, AWS OIDC, and SSM for zero-downtime EC2 deployments

experience.description: Engineered distributed systems, AI-powered interactive mobile platforms, and offline-first mobile applications adhering to clean architecture and test-driven development.
achievements: Built event-driven microservices platform (Ticketing App) utilizing NATS Streaming, MongoDB, and Next.js with comprehensive TDD unit and integration test suites in Jest
Developed interactive AI simulation platform (Voyage) with Flutter WebRTC and WebSocket signaling for low-latency audio/video streaming, Supabase, and Stripe/Khalti payments
Engineered offline-capable mobile blog platform with BLoC, GetIt dependency injection, and Hive local key-value caching
